about_the_game:
The witches are long gone. The blighted wasteland covered in mist they created remains. Build a colony of former familiars. Brave the toxic mists and maybe even restore the environment to what it once was.

BUILD A CITY FOR CATS

Make the perfect city for industrious cats with magical jobs. Manage food, power, and resources to keep your city growing. Unlock new technologies, buildings, and production chains that improve their quality of life and help you restore the environment.

RESHAPE THE LAND

Collect the mists that cover this world, convert it into water, and pour it into ravines. Grow grass for your crops and to make your cats happy. Craft explosives to blast new ravines and make your own rivers wherever you'd like.

ENDURE TOXIC GLOOM STORMS

The wasteland you find yourself in will occasionally remind that you're not welcome. Spores will rain down and spread amongst your city, spreading hazardous gloom creep. Gloom creep will kill your crops and make your cats sick if you're not prepared. Important note: this game does contain cat death! Sick cats just can't work until they're healed by a cat cleric.

CLEAN THEIR LITTER BOX

Your cats will let you know if they're not happy. Keep them fed with a variety of food, grow them grass to play on, build them a scratching post, and, most importantly, keep their litter box clean.

FEATURES:

🐈 Build a city for cats.

🏭 Manage resources like wood, food, and fuel with production chains to support your growing cat population.

🔬 Research new buildings and technologies.

📈 Balance kitten birth rates, crop growth, cat happiness, research, and power production to grow your city.

🌊 Reshape and terraform the land. Fill in old ravines and make new ones with explosives. Fill them with water for your farms or ink for fuel.

⛈️ Endure storms that will put a strain on your workers and your economy if you're unprepared.

⚙️ Customize your start with advanced settings. Adjust things like storm frequency, cat hunger rate, and workplace power draw.

🏖️ Relax in a colorful and chill atmosphere without fear of punishment or failure. Your cats will not die if you accidentally run out of food. (But they will be very upset with you.)

Disclaimer

No AI or machine learning of any kind was used during any part of this game's development.

name: Mistpaw Ravine Demo
short_description: The witches are gone. Only their cats remain. Make a new home for them in this feline city-builder. Keep your cats fed and happy, clean their litter box, and endure the toxic mist of a world ravaged by magic.
